newsitem.title: USA: INCSTAR to market test for Graves disease in Japan.
newsitem.headline: INCSTAR to market test for Graves disease in Japan.

text.p: INCSTAR Corp said Tuesday it has received clearance from the Japanese Ministry of Health to market its test to detect Graves' disease, the most common type of hyperthyroidism.
Hyperthyroidism is a metabolic imbalance that results from thyroid hormone overproduction.

About 200 million people in the world have some form of disease affecting the thyroid gland. This gland, located at the base of the neck, regulates body functions and produces hormones essential to growth and metabolism. Graves' disease affects about one in every 100 people and 80 to 90 percent of patients with hyperthyroidism. It is four to eight times more common in women than in men.
INCSTAR said its test can measure the severity of Graves' disease, as well as monitor its progression. Most other tests only rule out the possibility of the disease.
INCSTAR develops, produces and markets diagnostic tests worldwide. It generated 1995 sales of $46 million.
